description.value: Arbutus Inn is a 52-room, 3-story affordable hotel centrally located on Douglas Street in Victoria at the crossroads of Burnside Road East and Dunedin Street. Offering renovated rooms with free parking and a National Car & Truck Rental kiosk on site, it sits within easy reach of downtown Victoria, Mayfair Mall, and the Gorge Waterway. Guest reviews consistently praise the friendly and accommodating staff, including willingness to hold luggage after checkout.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is comprehensive and confirms the OSM record details (address, phone, name). No bike-specific amenities (storage, tools, wash) are mentioned anywhere on the site; parking references are exclusively for cars. Wi-Fi is explicitly confirmed across all room types and in the amenities list; luggage storage is confirmed by a September 2025 Google review quoting staff holding bags post-checkout; nearby evening food is confirmed by the Location page listing multiple restaurants within walking/short drive distance.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating hotel with recent guest reviews through April 2026; address, phone, and website all confirmed.
enrichment_extras.notes: No bike-specific amenities mentioned anywhere on the website. The hotel's free parking references are vehicle-oriented. Cyclists would benefit from direct inquiry about bike storage options.

Nearby evening food.detail: Location page lists several nearby restaurants including Glo Restaurant + Lounge (dinner), Green Elephant Thai Food, Ramen Arashi, and Emmaline's, described as a walk or very short drive away

Luggage storage.detail: Google review (September 2025): 'They even stored our luggage for a few hours after we had checked out so that we could do a little more sight seeing before we had to leave.'

wow_evidence: 52-room, 3-story affordable hotel... No bike-specific amenities mentioned
